mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_review_like (user_id, review_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{reviewId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.shop_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.is_ai_generated, r.like_count, r.status, r.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, 1 AS liked_by_me, s.name AS shop_name, s.avg_score AS shop_avg_score FROM user_review_like url JOIN review r ON url.review_id = r.id LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop s ON r.shop_id = s.id WHERE url.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY url.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_review_like url JOIN review r ON url.review_id = r.id WHERE url.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1
